# Move To honors the Asset's declared cancellation and progress support

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Enroll an Asset without cancellation or progress support

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "request_id": "<asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<asset credential>",
  "alias": "Limited",
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "scheduling": [
        "queued"
      ],
      "cancellation": false,
      "progress": false
    }
  ]
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "Limited",
    "change_sequence": 1,
    "command_manifest": [
      {
        "cancellation": false,
        "command_id": "move_to",
        "progress": false,
        "scheduling": [
          "queued"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "components": {
      "communications": {
        "link_state": "offline"
      },
      "heartbeat": {
        "last_seen": null
      },
      "status": {
        "reported_at": null,
        "value": "unknown"
      }
    },
    "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
    "id": "<asset>",
    "kind": "asset",
    "subtype": null,
    "version": 1
  },
  "credential_id": "<id-2>",
  "principal_id": "<id-3>"
}
```

## 2. Prepare Move To

SDK `GET /dataset` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

## 3. The supported Command still creates a Task

SDK `POST /tasks` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<limited submission>",
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "change_sequence": 2,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 2,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<limited task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<limited submission>",
  "version": 1
}
```

→ **200**
```json

  "change_sequence": 1,
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "cancellation": false,

    },

      "value": "unknown"
    }
  },
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "subtype": null,
  "version": 1
}
```

SDK `PATCH /entities/<asset>` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<unsupported manifest report>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "scheduling": [
        "immediate"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

→ **400**
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_command_manifest",
  "message": "The Asset advertises an unsupported Command or scheduling combination."
}
```

SDK `GET /entities/<asset>` with <operator key>

→ **200**

{

    {

        "queued"
      ]
    }
  ],

    "communications": {

    },

      "last_seen": null
    },

      "reported_at": null,
      "value": "unknown"
    }
  },
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",

## 5. Unsupported cancellation and progress fail without changing the Task

SDK `PATCH /tasks/<limited task>/status` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "status": "cancellation_requested",
  "request_id": "<unsupported cancellation>"
}
```

→ **409**
```json
{
  "code": "unsupported_cancellation",
  "message": "The assigned Asset did not advertise Task cancellation support."
}
```

SDK `PATCH /tasks/<limited task>/status` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<task report 1>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "status": "in_progress",
  "progress_percent": 10
}
```

→ **409**
```json
{
  "code": "unsupported_progress",
  "message": "The assigned Asset did not advertise Task progress support."
}
```

SDK `GET /tasks/<limited task>` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "change_sequence": 2,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 2,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<limited task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<limited submission>",
  "version": 1
}
```

## 6. The assigned Asset can still complete the Task

SDK `PATCH /tasks/<limited task>/status` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<task report 1>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "status": "completed"
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "change_sequence": 4,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 2,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<limited task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 40,
    "longitude": -70
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "completed",
  "submission_id": "<limited submission>",
  "version": 2
}
```
